notes.title: Character Customization and Clouds!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/524926201b46a9f2fa05d4e662f3c410cbaa9022.png[/img]
I’m thrilled to announce the release of Legacy version 0.5.7.5! Please note that this update requires a new save, meaning older saves won’t be compatible as we roll out these exciting changes. This version brings a wealth of customization with the addition of skin and hair color choices for your citizens, complete with subtle random variances in tones when citizens have children, adding depth to each generation. A tremendous amount of effort went into crafting new and improved scripts to bring these features to life, ensuring that every citizen feels unique and vibrant as your families grow and evolve over time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/68fbfa380b9cf902da1d560c7264e6806696b077.png[/img]
The skies of Legacy have also been transformed with the introduction of dynamic clouds that drift across the landscape, casting soft shadows and enhancing the atmosphere of your world. This new system involved extensive work on scripts and shaders to create a seamless, immersive experience as the clouds move with the wind, reflecting the beauty of nature. I’d love to hear your feedback on these updates—please comment and share your thoughts on how these changes shape your experience in Legacy! Your input helps guide the game’s future. Thank you for your support, I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Construction Update V0.5.7
notes.notes:
Construction is a big part of a city builder survival RPG game and I'm glad we have finally gotten here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/aa8b91da6f4ce56e16fb75b8f50c191eb32d78ea.png[/img]

A lot of work has gone into making the construction process for the buildings. This update brings the construction process to all of the primary buildings. There are still developer tools to allow for testing the process faster, but this update helps flesh out the gameplay of building your city. This system got streamlined down quite a few times while being developed and I am happy with the way it's working right now. One new dev tool that was added for this update is the instant build button located on the construction screen. The little green guy at the bottom left will finish your building without needing materials and can be used at any phase of the construction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/a91d936e3ab82fa7a0c67a949a7655c7356aa6fe.png[/img]

These past two updates contained a lot of new code. I hope you enjoy them!

notes.title: Build, Damage and Repair!
notes.notes: The buildings have received a large amount of functionality in this update including the ability to be damaged and repaired. More storage interactions have been added and the construction and demolition process is working for three of the buildings. This is a rather small update but it took forever to get these processes working. Fortunately these systems have been rewritten over the past couple months in order to work efficiently and will make it easier as more buildings are added. A few more inventory processes were added so that the construction and demolition processes work correctly. I hope you enjoy the progress!

notes.title: Hunter's Post
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/ce1f2c92a329edec0e7837b4b41a3070034b1011.png[/img]

The Hunter's Post brings a new level of gameplay to Legacy. Currently the Hunter's Post will simply spawn more meat and leather every couple minutes. This is temporary and will just simulate a hunter cutting up meat. Obviously this will change when the Hunter citizen is implemented. Only the player can pull items out of the hunter's post in this update, eventually the hunter will empty it into your other storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/d6de85879ab1e748206e10ba67a46c73b0ddec16.png[/img]

This update also brings the first building that needs to be constructed. After you have the materials to place the construction site, you will need to add resources to the site in order to start construction. Once you have all the resources you can then build by hitting it with a hammer. All other buildings that have already been implemented will be upgraded to this style over time. Demolishing the building is now a process as well.

This has been a very long update because this process changed a lot in the master and save files to make them ready for this new gameplay. This update was also a major step to prepare for the Builder citizen who will be able to interact with all buildings that are under construction. But mainly, during the span of this update my Mother passed away after a long fight against cancer. During her last few months I spent a lot less time at my desk. It's funny how at times like that I didn't really care too much about this project, but as a mother, she was interested in my projects and would continue to ask me about my progress. She will be missed.

notes.title: Cook and Firekeeper Jobs
notes.notes:
-NEW SAVE- This major update took over a month to get working. Added in this update is the citizen jobs Cook and Firekeeper. The campfires use either sticks or firewood to stay lit (when the bugs permit) and keeping them stocked became a chore once you got plenty of campfires in your village. So now the Firekeeper will make sure any campfire that is getting low will be topped off as well as swap out sticks for firewood if you have firewood available. In time, the plan is to have the fire keeper also cut firewood if there is none available, but that will be down the road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/9fb5df379f26216a7e53f600ce1d31d91bb0abf2.png[/img]

Also added in this update is the Cook. Currently this citizen can only cook raw meat into cooked meat with other recipes planned to come. The cook will keep an eye out for any raw meat placed into your storage buildings, they will then take the food to a campfire and proceed to cook it. Once finished the cook will return the cooked food to a storage building.

The other major change was the addition of plantable berry bushes. Keep in mind, gold berries only grow in higher altitudes. Some other UI changes were made and as always bug fixes are an ongoing task. I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Item Stats Update
notes.notes:
-NEW SAVE- Almost a major update with how much stuff went into the game these past two weeks. You now have leather to craft with, string is used and many crafted items have had a materials change. You can now throw rocks, no damage yet, but it is still as fun as it sounds. The map is working, the clothing and weapons now have stats on them and you can see the stats in the crafting menu. I added a pause game, x2 speed and improved the music button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/1bebab9f1ecb638a3e66c10157416dcc75abd6a9.png[/img]

This update is paving the way for more citizen jobs and more combat mechanics. This is a new save update so all your current progress will be lost. Unfortunately many of the upcoming versions will be new save updates because of modifying the save files. I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Citizens Love Peaches!
notes.notes:
Not quite a major update but this one was really hard and took a lot of time! You can now plant peach trees, and citizens will go to storage buildings when they get hungry, they'll get food out for themselves and continue on with their jobs. The campfires got some cleaning up. The woodcutter job got a few extra modifications and all of the structures got some stabilization and gameplay issues worked out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/f35bd7e7356a729f949eee8324409ded58678a63.png[/img]

Tired of waiting for rocks to respawn? Me too! Now you can use a mining pick on the large rock mounds and they will throw rocks at you. One step closer to the mining citizen. Besides these changes there was an issue with the oak tree so it has been temporarily removed from the game. The initial spawns of trees can be very random so don't be afraid to start fresh and see. There is no in-game reset yet so you'll still have to delete the save file.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.16
notes.notes: Fixed the grounded error and save location problem. Also included in this patch was the peach trees.

notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
This update brings the functionality of the campfires, apple collection and item drops. You can now drop items from your inventory and your citizens will come pick them up and put them away for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/1c223056e499fb92d57aaf46ae55fec93cba2d25.png[/img]

Citizens will also gather apples for you now. Campfires use stick to stay lit and citizens will not gather around a campfire that goes out at night. Other fixes and changes inside. I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
This is a fairly large update considering what all went into it. In game there are newer features like the campfires now burn through their inventory, if they go out the citizens won't be able to rest there at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/1c223056e499fb92d57aaf46ae55fec93cba2d25.png[/img]

Citizens will now collect your apples for you as well as items you drop from your inventory. Character movement has been modified, I wish I could say improved.. it runs smother but still has some issues.

notes.title: Inventory Update
notes.notes: This is a much needed update that adds the ability to move items in the inventory by double clicking on them. This also added a lot of improvements to the inventory logic and a few of the menus. In order for this update to work a bunch of the citizen code was modified and while I was at it the citizens can now wear shoes.

notes.title: Woodcutter Update
notes.notes: The citizens have ben updated with a new profession: the Woodcutter. This option created a whole new set of issues in the code and it took what seemed like forever to sort them out. Now you can assign the woodcutter task to your citizens provide them with an axe and a woodshed and they will get to work clearing the forest for you. The citizen rest state has been improved on with more to come.

notes.title: House Inventories V0.4.95
notes.notes:
This is the last update before the Citizen updates. Version 0.4.95 has brought the last batch of functionality to the housing structures. This was key for the citizens to be able to access the materials and/or benefit from the furniture within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/80decfb1be5f714487773795032b83b3bdaa8c11.png[/img]

During the next few updates more systems will be added to the buildings as the citizen's functions will be built on. This update will create a new save and all previous progress will be lost.

notes.title: Version 0.4.9 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757109/c89750edfb54b3283920c111b790113458a04706.png[/img]

This update brings another building into the mix, the stockpile, this is a small and cheap structure that can store anything. Citizens can now interact with these structures and chose which items should go to these structures first. For example, sticks will always be put in the stockpile first if there is room, leaving more room in your barns for fruit.
